description: Cast an I Ching reading with the traditional three-coin method (six tosses, bottom line first). Returns the primary hexagram, any changing lines and the relating (transformed) hexagram, with links to each hexagram's meaning. Use this instead of making up a hexagram.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

question.description: The question being asked (echoed back only; not stored).

name: cast_i_ching
title: Cast an I Ching hexagram
